findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#ec-logo" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.

findings.message: @font-face 'sj mono' only names a font installed on this machine (src: local()). A local render uses the installed copy; a cloud render or another machine has none and falls back to a different font.
findings.fixHint: Add a url() source to the font file (.woff2) inside the project, or use a Google Fonts family, so every render draws the same glyphs.

findings.message: <path> is hidden with stroke-dasharray 1 1 and stroke-dashoffset 1 on pathLength 1, but its round cap can still paint a dot at the end of the path (Chrome rounds the zero-length dash differently per curve).
findings.fixHint: Make the gap longer than the path (stroke-dasharray "1 1.2" with stroke-dashoffset 1.1), or keep the element visibility:hidden until its draw tween starts.
